# Rudraksha Multispecialty Hospital

> Leading multispecialty hospital providing comprehensive eye care, diabetes management, and internal medicine services in Vadodara, Gujarat. Expert doctors, advanced technology, and compassionate care.

Important notes:
- Official site: https://rudrakshamultispecialityhospial.com/
- Primary services/products: Cataract Surgery, LASIK & Refractive Error, Pterygium, Retina Treatment, Glaucoma, Dry Eye, Type 1 & 2 Diabetes, Gestational Diabetes, Jaundice, Convulsion, Dengue, CV Stroke.
- Primary location/service area: Vadodara, Gujarat, India.
- Contact: contact@rudrakshamultispecialityhospial.com, Phone: +91 63536 47003
- Content policy: Public information intended to assist patients in understanding hospital services.
